title: Bella K NDE 6148
content: All I can remember is music that was kind of in the back ground that was almost like notes within notes. The song that reminds me of it the most is 'The Carol of the Bells.' I remember feeling very peaceful. I was sitting at a very plain wooden table and there was white all around the man, who was Jesus, who sat next to me. I remember feeling a sense of total love. There was no judgment, only pure love and I felt so good in his presence. I remember we were talking without using words. I would look into his eyes and find all the answers I was searching for. I remember expressing to him my confusion about the holy trinity and I remember his answer, somewhat. Maybe I remember the feeling of his answer would be the best way to describe it. I remember feeling very peaceful, as if I would be happy never having to leave. The next thing I remember is my cousin straddling my chest with my shirt bunched in her hands, her face contorted in worry saying, 'Get up, get up; you cannot die in my house! Get up!' I was completely confused as to why she was there and what she was doing. It was so sudden. I was sitting with Jesus one second and then my cousin on top of me trying to get me up. I then remember that she drug me up the stairs and threw me out the side door and I landed in the yard and realized at that point that it seemed it was the first time I had taken a breath. Gasping for breath as if I weren't breathing at all before, yet I didn't feel the stress of that before I was outside. After some time we went back in the house, opened all the windows and tried to figure out what to do. We were so confused we never even called the fire department. We called my dad who told us we were lucky not to have been blown to high hell and he made sure we turned it off. I called the doctor who said I would be fine (I am not sure why he said that) but I did have to get medical treatment and had the most horrid cough for weeks (it was so bad that I would lay on the bathroom floor and wish for death since I could hardly breathe).

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus sat next to the experiencer at a very plain wooden table; there was "white all around" him.

environment.environment_other_detail: A very plain wooden table; "white all around" Jesus.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Apparent gas exposure/near asphyxiation in a house (father said they were lucky not to have been "blown"; windows opened; later severe cough and difficulty breathing).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Music in the background; sitting at a plain wooden table with Jesus; sudden return to cousin trying to rouse her; first breath felt upon being dragged outside.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel described; direct scene with Jesus at a table, then sudden return to the body/physical emergency.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Prominent auditory element: complex "notes within notes" music reminiscent of "The Carol of the Bells."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “There was no judgment, only pure love.” / “I was sitting with Jesus one second and then my cousin on top of me trying to get me up.” / “Get up, get up; you cannot die in my house! Get up!”
